name: Strike
description:
Make an unarmed or weapon attack, rolling against a Reflex saving throw of the target. 
Attacks after the first each turn take a stacking multiple attack penalty

name: Stride
description: Move a number of tiles up to your land speed

name: Leap
description:
Jump up to 3 tiles horizontally.
You may attempt a athletics check to jump farther, DC is 15 for 4 tiles and increases by 5 for each additional tile.

name: Step
description:
Move one tile without triggering reactions. 
You cannot Step into difficult terrain

name: Fly
description:
Move a number of tiles up to your fly speed. 
Flying one tile upwards costs two movement, opposite for downwards

name: Glide
description:
Move a number of tiles up to your glide speed. 
You cannot Glide upwards and you fall one tile downwards per four you fly forwards (minimum one per round).

name: Swim
description:
Move a number of tiles up to your swim speed. 
If you don't have a Swim speed you can make a Athletics check, moving half you land speed on Success

name: Glide
description: Move a number of tiles up to your glide speed.

name: Sneak
description:
Make a stealth check. 
On a success you can move at half speed while staying hidden
You attempt a stealth check with a -5 penalty to move at full speed

name: Crawl
description: Move one tile.

name: Cast a Spell
description: Make a spellshaping check (Int + Dex + Proficiency) compared to the difficulty of the spell. On a success the spell is cast and the result of spellshaping check is used for the DC of any saving throws imposed by the spell

name: Reinforce Aura
description: Spend mana up to your level + your Wil times 2, and restore aura health by that amount.

name: Aura Block
trigger: When you would partially block damage with your aura.
description: Block the force of the attack with your Aura, making it take all of the damage. If it breaks your aura, you take the remaining damage.

name: Harness Mana
description:
Attempt to absorb mana from the air, making a WIL check compared to mana density of the region. 
On a success you recover some mana.
On a critical failure you gain one level of mana poisoning. 
You have +2 to the check and the mana recovered is increased if you spent two actions to Harness Mana.

name: Stand Up
description: Stand up from Prone

name: Drop
description: Become Prone.

name: Escape
description:
Attempt to become free from being Grappled or Restrained. 
Roll Brawling or Acrobatics, one a success you become grappled instead of restrained or free if already grappled.
On a critical success you immediately become free

name: Take Cover
description: Gain cover or upgrade cover to Greater Cover

name: Identify Spell
trigger: You see a spell being cast
description:
Make an Arcana check against the spells unmodified spellshaping DC. 
On a critical success you gain a +2 bonus to saves against the spell

name: Stabilize
trigger: You are holding a medicine kit
description:
Make a Medicine check, DC 10 + Creature's dying Value.
On a success the creature reduces its dying by 2, or 4 on a Critical Success

name: Drink Potion
trigger: You are holding a potion or have one on a potion belt
description: Gain the benefits of the potion

name: Feed Potion
trigger: You are holding a potion or have one on a potion belt
description: Feed an willing adjacent creature a potion, giving them the benefits

name: Sustain
description: Extends the duration of a spell that you are sustaining by 1 turn When you sustain a spell make a spellshaping roll as if you were casting the spell. You cannot fail the spell when sustaining it, but the DC changes to the new spellshaping result Some spells have effects that happen when you sustain such as moving the spell. You cannot sustain a spell more than once per turn, but you can sustain multiple spells in the same turn using multiple sustain actions

name: High Jump
description:
Jump up to 2 tiles vertically
You may attempt a athletics check to jump higher, DC is 18 for 3 tiles and increases by 8 for each additional tile.

name: Recall Knowledge
description: Make an Arcana, Crafting, History, Nature or Society to find out what you know about a creature, place or organisation.

name: Battlefield Medicine
trigger: You are holding a medicine kit
description:
Make a Mend Wounds Check, but without removing wounded. 
Creatures can only have their health restored by Battlefield Medicine once per day

name: Mend Wounds
trigger: You are holding a medicine kit
description:
Make a DC 10 medicine check on a target.
On a success you restore 1d6 + 2 health to the creature and reduce it's wounded value by 1. 
On a critical success restore twice the amount and reduce wounded by 2.

name: Intimidate
description:
With threatening words or gestures, attempt to frighten a foe.
Make a Intimidation check against their Will save. 
On a success they are Frightened 1, on a critical success they are Frightened 2
